people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul

people.name: Ahitub
people.line: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul

people.name: Doeg
people.line: Edomite chief shepherd who betrayed David to Saul

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Nob
people.line: A city of priests near Jerusalem

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
translations.bsb: But Doeg the Edomite, who had stationed himself with Saul’s servants, answered: “I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub at Nob.
translations.kjv: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
translations.asv: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
